item.title: Unboxing Color
item.description: So often the reality of our paintings falls short of our ability to envision them - we can “see” the most beautiful paintings in our imagination, but in reality, that beauty eludes us. It’s often an issue with controlling value and just as often, color. Both value and color can make or breaks a painting. [...]
